The structure leans on the **two‑page home‑screen template** you already use [[summaries/session-02_2024-06-15]] and the **attention‑control** principles that keep experiments purposeful [[concepts/attention-control]]. | Day | Action | Why it works | |-----|--------|--------------| | **Monday – Set‑up** | 1. Pick **5** new apps you want to explore (e.g., a new photo editor, language‑learning tool, finance tracker, productivity timer, and a niche news reader).
2. Add them to the **top‑row of Page 2** (Row 1) of your home‑screen layout.
3. Put each app in its own **folder “Extras‑Week X”** (or leave them as icons) for quick removal later. | Placing the week’s test set on a dedicated row makes the rotation visible and limits the number you’ll actually open, reducing decision fatigue. | | **Tuesday – First‑look** | Open each new app for **5 min** (or one quick task). 3. Moving a successful test to Page 1 integrates it into your core set without expanding the overall icon count. | | **Saturday – Reset** | Clear the “Extras‑Week X” folder, ensuring no stray icons remain.
